en.bdb: The glory of the wash of the Guru feet

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਖੁਦਾਇ ਪੀਰ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਚੇਲਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: gur govi(n)dh khudhai peer gur chelaa chelaa gur hoaa|

en.bdb: Guru Hargobind is the Lord in the form of Guru. Earlier a disciple he is now a. Guru i.e. earlier Gurus and Guru Hargobind are the same.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਪਛੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: nira(n)kaar aakaar kar eka(n)kaar akaar pachhoaa|

en.bdb: First, the formless Lord assumed the form of the Ekarikar and later he created all the forms (i.e. universe).

verses.gurmukhi: ਓਅੰਕਾਰ ਅਕਾਰੁ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਦਰੀਯਾਉ ਕਰੇਂਦੇ ਢੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: oa(n)kaar akaar lakh lakh dhareeyaau kare(n)dhe ddoaa|

en.bdb: In the form of Oatikär (Guru) lacs of streams of life take shelter.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਦਰੀਆਉ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ੍ਰ ਗੜਾੜ ਸਮੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: lakh dhareeaau samu(n)dhr vich sat samu(n)dhr gaRaaR samoaa|

en.bdb: Lacs of rivers flow into seas, and all the seven seas merge in the oceans.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਗੜਾੜ ਕੜਾਹ ਵਿਚਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਦਝਹਿ ਸੀਖ ਪਰੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: lakh gaRaaR kaRaeh vich tirasanaa dhajheh seekh paroaa|

en.bdb: In the cauldron of desires of fire, the creatures of lacs of oceans hooked in skewers are getting roasted.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਵਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਬੂੰਦ ਇਕੁ ਠੰਢੇ ਤਤੇ ਹੋਇ ਖਲੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: baavan cha(n)dhan boo(n)dh ik Tha(n)dde tate hoi khaloaa|

en.bdb: All these burning creatures attain peace by the one drop of sandal-delight of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਵਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਚਰੋਣਦਕ ਹੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: baavan cha(n)dhan lakh lakh charan kaval charonadhak hoaa|

en.bdb: And lacs of such sandals have got created from the wash of the Guru's lotus feet.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਆਦੇਸੁ ਅਲੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: paarabraham pooran braham aadh purakh aadhes aloaa|

en.bdb: By the order of the transcendent, primeaval perfect God, the canopy
And the royal umbrella are held over the head of Guru Hargobind.
